lines.text: [00:26] BUG: balance goes negative when two tabs redeem the same card at once
lines.body: balance goes negative when two tabs redeem the same card at once

lines.text: Steps: 1. Open checkout for a $40 order in two tabs. 2. Apply the $50 card in both. 3. Pay in tab 1, then pay in tab 2 within a few seconds.
Expected: The second payment uses only the $10 left on the card and charges $30 to the card.
Actual: Both orders took $40 from the gift card; the Gift cards page now shows -$30.00.
Env: staging 1.5.0-rc2, Chrome 131, two tabs
Evidence: screenshots/negative-balance.png
[00:34] INVESTIGATE: tried again with a 10 second gap between tabs - balance stayed correct, so it only happens when both pay close together
lines.body: tried again with a 10 second gap between tabs - balance stayed correct, so it only happens when both pay close together
